entries.title: Psalms 72:1
segments: ¶<<For Solomon.>> O God, give the king thy judgments, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.

entries.title: Psalms 72:2
segments: ¶He will judge thy people with righteousness, and thine afflicted with judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 72:3
segments: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the hills, by righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 72:4
segments: He will do justice to the afflicted of the people; he will save the children of the needy, and will break in pieces the oppressor.

entries.title: Psalms 72:5
segments: They shall fear thee as long as sun and moon endure, from generation to generation.

entries.title: Psalms 72:6
segments: He shall come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:7
segments: In his days shall the righteous flourish, and abundance of peace till the moon be no more.

entries.title: Psalms 72:8
segments: And he shall have dominion from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:9
segments: The dwellers in the desert shall bow before him, and his enemies shall lick the dust.

entries.title: Psalms 72:10
segments: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render presents; the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer tribute:

entries.title: Psalms 72:11
segments: Yea, all kings shall bow down before him; all nations shall serve him.

entries.title: Psalms 72:12
segments: For he will deliver the needy who crieth, and the afflicted, who hath no helper;

entries.title: Psalms 72:13
segments: He will have compassion on the poor and needy, and will save the souls of the needy:

entries.title: Psalms 72:14
segments: He will redeem their souls from oppression and violence, and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

entries.title: Psalms 72:15
segments: And he shall live; and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba; and prayer shall be made for him continually: all the day shall he be blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 72:16
segments: There shall be abundance of corn in the earth, upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon; and they of the city shall bloom like the herb of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:17
segments: His name shall endure for ever; his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and [men] shall bless themselves in him; all nations shall call him blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 72:18
segments: ¶Blessed be Jehovah Elohim, the God of Israel, who alone doeth wondrous things!

entries.title: Psalms 72:19
segments: And blessed be his glorious name for ever! and let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen, and Amen.

entries.title: Psalms 72:20
segments: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
